name: RAPHANUS SATIVUS
key_symptoms: Putrid eructations. Burning in epigastrium, followed by hot eructation.
Pain in chest extends to back and to throat. Heavy lump and coldness in center of chest.
Sadness, aversion to children, especially girls. Headache, brain feels tender and sore. Śdema of lower eyelids. Mucus in posterior nares.

gi_symptoms: Putrid eructations. Burning in epigastrium, followed by hot eructation.
urinary_symptoms: Nervous irritation of genitals. Menses very profuse and long-lasting. Nymphomania, with aversion to her own sex and to children, and sexual insomnia.
Urine.--Turbid, with yeast-like sediment. Urine more copious, thick like milk.
